items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee addresses Ken Kimery as 'Ken' in the transcript ('Did you know that, Ken?'), and Kimery is identified as the recording engineer/interviewer. The text shows no personal or professional relationship beyond the interview context.

ctx.x: Don Lamond, another great player. I used to see Don Lamond – he comes from Washington, D.C., by the way. Did you know that, Ken?
